cases.setup: Pinned public Python analyzer checkout with declaration, lookup and annotation tests; no current mechanism facts recorded.
checks: Review output identifies current binding construction, load resolution, annotation context and regression owners with hashed anchors.
Observed diagnostics are recorded separately for bare, quoted and future annotation probes.
The operation leaves tracked code contents unchanged.
Missing owners or inconclusive probes produce UNKNOWN rather than fabricated compatibility.

cases.setup: Compatible resolution review is observed; annotation-only declarations are currently discarded and public regression owner is bound.
checks: Patch represents no-value annotated declarations separately from value-bearing assignments.
Lookup distinguishes postponed contexts from eager bare annotation context.
Nested annotation context exits restore the previous state.
Patch includes public eager, quoted, future and unused-variable assertions.
Prior public-validation-observed evidence is marked stale without invalidating the required ordinary-value and unused-variable behavior assurances.

cases.setup: An unvalidated current Python repair and publicly bound test commands are available.
checks: Executed results show undefined T for eager bare T and no undefined T for quoted T.
Executed future-annotation results accept both bare and quoted T.
Ordinary no-value loads without postponement retain undefined-name diagnostics and value-bearing bindings retain ordinary lookup behavior.
Module/class annotation-only declarations and the historically documented annotation-only local yield no unused-variable warning.
An annotation followed by an unused value assignment yields one unused-variable warning.
Validation records commands and outcomes and sets public-validation-observed only when all required checks pass.
Unavailable commands yield UNKNOWN; failed assertions yield FAIL rather than a repair-success claim.
